blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — State witness Roberto Bernardo, former Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) undersecretary, said on Thursday that he never had any dealings with former Speaker Martin Romualdez. Bernardo said this in his testimony before the Sandiganbayan Third Division during the bail hearing of Romualdez for plunder over alleged kickbacks worth P7.44 billion. Romualdez’s lawyer, Thea Daep, asked Bernardo if he had dealings with the Leyte lawmaker, and the witness responded: “There is nothing like that.” He added that he mentioned Romualdez only once in his affidavit.
